OFFICIAL ADMISSION NOTICE

📢 New Merit Lists Announced

Candidates are advised to check the newly announced merit lists
and complete their admission formalities within the prescribed deadline.

Deadline: October 19, 2026

Complete all required admission formalities before the deadline
to avoid any inconvenience.

Access Merit List → (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2026/10/merit-lists-announced-for-admissions.html)

Directorate of Admissions

Contact: +92-311-0004924 | +92-316-0004934

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

IMPORTANT ACADEMIC ANNOUNCEMENT

📢 IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT FOR STUDENTS

Mid-Term Examinations

FALL 2026

Examinations Commence:

Monday, 26 October 2026

View Examination Details → (https://news.awkum.edu.pk/2026/10/important-announcement-for-students-mid.html)

📌 DO NOT WAIT UNTIL THE LAST DAY!

Take the necessary steps now to ensure a smooth and hassle-free
examination process.

Director Academics & Research

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
